name: smwblocks-specific-screen-conditional-vertical-exit-enabled-pipe
title: Specific Screen + Conditional Vertical Exit-Enabled Pipe
description:
Similar to the specific screen teleport blocks, this vertical pipe will teleport you to a specific screen exit. It can also be set up to teleport to a different screen exit depending on a condition, such as the P-switch being active, the number of exits collected and much more.

Make sure to edit the settings file and keep it in the blocks folder, but don't insert it directly - only insert the left and right blocks.
